fullContentHtml:
SSC CPO SI PET/ PST Result 2026 – Full Details

Staff Selection Commission (SSC) has released the PET/ PST Result for the post of Sub Inspector in Delhi Police and Central Armed Police Forces Examination, 2025 on the official website of SSC. This recruitment was released for 3073. posts. Applications for the SSC CPO SI Recruitment 2025 were accepted from September 26, 2025, to October 16, 2025. The PET/PST examination was held on 21-28 July 2026. Candidates who appeared for this examination can download their SSC CPO SI PET/ PST Result 2026 from the link given below.

Important Dates

  • Notification Date : 26 September 2025
  • Application Start Date : 26 September 2025
  • Last Date : 16 October 2025
  • Fee Payment Last Date : 17 September 2025
  • Correction Date : 03-05 November 2025
  • Exam Date : 09-12 December 2025
  • Self Slot Booking : 17-21 November 2025
  • Exam City Details : 29 November 2025
  • Admit Card : 07 December 2025
  • Answer Key : 24 December 2025
  • Result : 30 March 2026
  • Marks : 21 April 2026
  • PET/ PST Exam Date : 21-28 July 2026
  • PET/ PST Admit Card : 14 July 2026
  • PET/ PST Result : 14 July 2026

Application Fee

  • General, EWS, OBC : Rs. 100/-
  • SC, ST, Female : 0/-

How to Check Result

  1. Click on the direct official result link provided below.
  2. Enter your Roll Number / Registration Number and Date of Birth.
  3. Submit the form to view your scorecard on screen.
  4. Download and print a copy of the result for future reference.
